summary: Currenc Group Inc. (Nasdaq: CURR), a Singapore-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing that it and Animoca Brands mutually agreed to suspend merger negotiations under their non-binding November 2, 2025 term sheet, whereby Currenc would acquire Animoca via an Australian scheme of arrangement; Animoca holders would have owned roughly 95% of the merged entity, Currenc holders 5%. Exclusivity lapsed June 30, 2026; the term sheet contemplated a Q3 2026 close with a December 31, 2026 long stop. Talks may resume; financing flexibility cited. Watch for renewed talks or a break.
